title: Historical-Feature Residual Adaptation for Sequential Screening
abstract: arXiv:2610.19315v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sequential screening policies must use acquired feedback effectively under a fixed experiment budget. We study acquisition-time residual adaptation: a small ranking correction built from fixed historical features and anchored to base scores recorded before feedback is revealed. The interface accepts a history-conditioned scorer and a candidate feature table; its primary instantiation augments AssayFormer's ten-dimensional representation with 64 historical directions while retaining the pretrained model. In retrospective evaluation on 20 official-test screens from 15 recorded sources, a comparison fixed before target-outcome access increased source-macro fraction of hits recovered from 22.58% to 28.61%, exceeding all six prespecified comparators. translated_title: 面向顺序筛选的历史特征残差自适应
translated_abstract: 顺序筛选策略必须在固定的实验预算下有效利用已获取的反馈。我们研究了采集时刻的残差自适应：一种由固定历史特征构建的小型排序校正，并锚定于在反馈揭示之前记录的基础分数。该接口接受一个以历史为条件的打分器和一个候选特征表；其主要实例化方式是在保留预训练模型的同时，用64个历史方向来扩充AssayFormer的十维表示。在来自15个记录来源的20个官方测试筛选任务的回顾性评估中，一个在接触目标结果之前就已固定的对比设置将按来源宏平均的命中回收率从22.58%提升至28.61%，超过了全部六个预先指定的对比方法。使用相同特征的普通排序头达到了25.73%。补充的强逻辑回归、排序融合和未投影对照分别达到了26.42%、26.02%和26.78%。另一个模型独立（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种利用固定历史特征构建、锚定于反馈揭示前基础分数的采集时刻残差自适应方法，在保留预训练模型的前提下将顺序筛选的命中回收率从22.58%提升至28.61%，超越了所有六个预先指定的对比方法。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes acquisition-time residual adaptation built from fixed historical features and anchored to pre-feedback base scores, which preserves the pretrained model and boosts the source-macro fraction of hits recovered from 22.58% to 28.61% in sequential screening, outperforming all six prespecified comparators.
